---
applyTo: "{server/**,supabase/**,.github/workflows/**,Dockerfile,docker-compose.yml,.env.example}"
---
Security-sensitive changes require human approval. Never disable RLS, bypass admin_users, expose secrets, trust proxy headers by default, auto-merge, or auto-deploy. Review CORS allowlists, rate limiting, request validation, token handling, and Telegram approval flow. Never log tokens or raw authorization headers.
